description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate whats next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor''s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens? Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are looking for a passionate Java Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using modern full-stack technologies. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, React, APIs, cloud platforms, and AI-assisted engineering practices. You will work in a collaborative Agile environment, leveraging modern development tools and AI-powered engineering methodologies to deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality solutions.
  
  

* Role: Java Full Stack Developer (AI-Driven Engineering & SpecKit)
* Location: All Persistent Locations
* Experience: 5 to 8 Years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise applications using Java 17+, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, REST APIs, and relational databases.
* Design and implement scalable microservices and API-first solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including specification creation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Apply SpecKit practices and AI-Driven Lifecycle (AIDLC) methodologies to improve engineering effectiveness and delivery quality.
* Utilize GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and increase productivity.
* Build reusable UI components, APIs, and configuration-driven solutions that support scalability and maintainability.
* Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers to deliver business-critical applications.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, automated testing, release management, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues while driving continuous improvement and performance optimization.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, security practices, and software engineering best practices.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 5-8 years of hands-on experience in Java Full Stack application development.
* Strong expertise in Java 17+, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices Architecture, and API-first development.
* Experience building modern web applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Proficiency in relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or SQL Server, including database design and optimization.
* Hands-on experience with Git, branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Experience using GitHub Copilot, SpecKit, Claude, or similar AI-assisted software engineering tools.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Knowledge of Kafka, event-driven architecture, messaging systems, and asynchronous communication patterns.
* Experience designing configuration-driven or metadata-driven enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, code quality practices, and application security.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to technical discussions and solution design.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment**
Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React, Python, AI)
description:
**Hiring for ClearRoute**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

ClearRoute is a global platform engineering consultancy, headquartered in London with engineering hubs in Pune and Bengaluru. It helps large enterprises bring digital products to market faster, cheaper and more safely, across cloud platforms, quality engineering and developer experience, and it puts AI at the centre of how software gets delivered. ClearRoute is growing its India engineering team for enterprise client engagements and is hiring two senior full-stack engineers who can build AI-enabled applications end to end.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer you'll build, deploy and optimise scalable, high-performance web applications that handle large volumes of data and integrate AI-driven components. You'll work closely with backend engineers, cloud specialists and AI teams to ship intelligent, production-ready applications at scale. This is a full-time role, hybrid from Pune or Bengaluru.

**What you'll do**

* Design, build and maintain scalable front-end applications in React and modern TypeScript/JavaScript, backed by Python services
* Build front ends that stay fast and responsive under high data throughput
* Integrate applications with AI-powered services: LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, LLM workflows and agentic AI systems

* Support CI/CD and make deployments reliable and repeatable

title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer
description:
Wolters Kluwer is seeking a motivated and talented DevSecOps Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with hands-on experience in mature software engineering and a DevSecOps environment to further develop their skills and make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization. As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our engineering team, contributing to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of our enterprise cloud platform.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for working closely with various stakeholders, including our experienced engineering team, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance, and other key partners. Your primary focus will be on engineering practices to streamline our software development processes, enhance efficiency, and ensure the reliability and scalability of our cloud platform. You will gain hands-on experience with a variety of DevSecOps tools and application and platform technologies, helping to build and maintain our continuous integration and delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment processes.
  
  
You will be involved in a wide range of tasks, including application and platform automation, infrastructure management, monitoring, and performance optimization. Your foundational understanding of application and platform engineering concepts, practices, and tools will be critical as you contribute to the implementation of best practices and the optimization of our platform workflows. You will have the opportunity to learn from and collaborate with seasoned professionals, gaining valuable insights and experience that will help you grow in your career.
  
  
As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will be expected to actively participate in the design, development, and deployment of our cloud applications. You will work on projects that require keen attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality. Your ability to collaborate effectively with team members and communicate clearly will be essential in ensuring the successful delivery of our application and platform solutions.
  
  
This position offers a fantastic opportunity for growth and career development within a supportive and innovative environment. You will have the chance to work with state-of-the-art technologies, be part of a collaborative and high-performing team and make a significant impact on our organization’s success. If you are passionate about engineering and eager to take your career to the next level, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Wolters Kluwer.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Support architecture for complex applications ensuring they meet business requirements.
* Implement best practices in coding with support of AI
* IaC-first approach to managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform and an opinionated IaC Framework standard.
* Transform manual processes using automation.
* Perform the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of platforms.
* Conduct work activities using SRE principles, such as resilience, metrics, capacity planning, toil, Incident management and security
* Manage cloud infrastructure and services in Azure and AWS
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, operations, QA, etc.).
* Communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Implement and Manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
* Develop scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency.
* Build and help transform container and serverless architectures, such as AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service), EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Services), Docker and Azure Functions.
* Ensure software and platforms comply with security standards and regulations.
* Implement security best practices and conduct regular security assessments.
* Adhere to access controls and protect sensitive data.
* Document processes, procedures, and infrastructure setups.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Continuously improve systems, processes, and methodologies.
* Participate in project planning and execution.
* Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and refine requirements.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through reliable and high-quality deliverables.
* Explore generative AI technologies to enhance software capabilities.
* Deploy AI models for automated content generation and predictive analytics.

**Other Duties**

* Performs other duties as assigned by management
* On call rotation responsibilities with the Service Delivery and Operations Team

**Job Qualifications & Experience**
**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field
* Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevSecOps engineering discipline, prefer enterprise engineering experience or equivalent
* Experience with Application and Infrastructure Operations, with AKS knowledge and Terraform IaC knowledge strongly preferred
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) for automation tasks and infrastructure management.
* Comprehensive experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure), including designing and implementing cloud services and architecture. Azure is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment, ensuring platform reliability and scalability.

**Thought Leadership and Soft skills:**

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn and contribute to team success.

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

description:

In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.

Customer Onboarding & Data Integration

* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: FinCrime Data Analyst Lead
description:
Join us as a FinCrime Agile Data Analyst - VP at Barclays, where you will act as the Data Analytics Lead for Financial Crime Agile Testing. You will oversee data analytics work performed within the Agile Testing team and define the analytical testing approach for individual reviews. Working in partnership with Agile Testing colleagues, you will translate review triggers into executable objectives, hypotheses and data analytics testing plans, provide input to review scope, and determine data requirements and analytical design. You will quality-control analytical scripts and outputs, communicate data-led findings and observations to stakeholders, and act as the escalation route for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts. Through independent judgement, technical assurance and constructive challenge, you will help deliver timely, risk-based and hypothesis-led testing of Financial Crime processes and controls.
  
  
Purpose of the Role
  
  
To oversee and lead the data analytics work supporting Financial Crime Agile Testing reviews. The role determines the overall data analytics approach, defines executable analytical objectives, hypotheses and testing plans for individual reviews, provides quality control over analytical scripts and outputs, and translates data into testable insight that supports assessment of the operational effectiveness of Financial Crime controls.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
  

* Oversee data analytics work performed within the Financial Crime Agile Testing team, including defining the data analytics testing strategy required for individual reviews.
* Translate review triggers into executable objectives, hypotheses and data analytics testing plans, providing data-led input to scoping decisions in collaboration with non-Data Analytics review colleagues.
* Provide leadership and technical oversight for the development of analytical test objectives, methodologies and scripts using SQL, Python and SAS; review and approve analytical work to support robust and reproducible testing outcomes.
* Identify and agree data needs and analytical design with the Agile Testing Lead during review planning and test-plan development.
* Coordinate delivery of analytics with the Agile Testing Lead during testing execution, while Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts design scripts, source data and perform analysis.
* Perform quality-control reviews of analytical scripts, including SQL, SAS and Python, designed by Data Analytics Specialists and/or Data Analytics Analysts, challenging logic, assumptions, data quality, caveats and the sufficiency of analytical evidence.
* Review analytical outputs and workpaper content to support clear, accurate and reproducible documentation of the testing performed, evidence obtained and conclusions supported by the analysis.
* Interpret and communicate findings and observations arising from data analytics testing to external stakeholders and provide analytical insight and draft input to review conclusions and reporting.
* Act as the escalation route for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts, addressing analytical judgement matters within authority and escalating material risk, scope, timeline or stakeholder issues where appropriate.
* Work alongside the Agile Testing Lead as part of stage-gate oversight and peer cross-review, preserving independent challenge and clear accountability between Testing and Data Analytics roles.
* Support the ongoing review and improvement of data analytics requirements within the Agile Testing methodology and contribute to efficient, risk-based and hypothesis-led review delivery.
* Maintain independence and objectivity, ensure timely escalation, secure evidence retention, data-privacy compliance and high-quality documentation across data analytics work.

Stakeholder Management and Leadership
  
  
The role requires strong engagement across business teams and larger FinCrime Agile testing team. The VP determines the overall data analytics approach and analytical scoping decisions for individual reviews. The role exercises independent judgement when setting analytical hypotheses and approaches, reviews work completed by Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts, and acts as their escalation route. The role also contributes to the strategic development of the Financial Crime Agile Testing analytics capability and adoption of improved tools and techniques
  
  
**Basic / Essential Qualifications**

* Strong experience leading data analytics work in Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Assurance or another control-testing environment.
* Strong SQL and Python capability, including the ability to review and challenge analytical scripts, logic, assumptions and outputs developed by others.
* Experience translating risk or review triggers into analytical objectives, hypotheses, testing plans, data requirements and executable analytical approaches.
* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes, risks and controls across relevant domains such as AML, Sanctions, Customer Due Diligence/KYC, Fraud or Transaction Monitoring.
* Experience applying data analytics to assess control effectiveness using full-population or targeted testing approaches.
* Strong technical assurance, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify data-quality issues, anomalies, control weaknesses, caveats and limitations.
* Experience reviewing analytical evidence and workpapers to determine whether testing outputs sufficiently support observations and conclusions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, collaboration and constructive-challenge skills, with the ability to exercise independent judgement and escalate appropriately.
* Ability to coordinate analytical delivery, provide technical guidance and act as an escalation point for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts.

Desirable Skillsets
  
  
  

* Experience contributing to Financial Crime assurance or Agile Testing methodology and improving analytical testing standards or ways of working.
* Experience with SAS, data visualisation tools such as Tableau, statistical analysis, data mining or AI-enabled analytics.
* Experience developing reusable analytical assets or automated testing approaches that improve testing efficiency, consistency or coverage.
* Knowledge of advanced statistical or machine-learning techniques used to identify patterns, trends and relationships in data.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support and enhance our internal healthcare application platform. You will handle Kubernetes-based application deployments, CI/CD pipeline support, infrastructure automation, platform reliability, and cost optimization. You will work within established standards and security practices.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Deploy, upgrade, and maintain healthcare applications on Kubernetes using standardized patterns and Helm charts.
* Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps practices.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and routine operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Monitor platform health, respond to alerts, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Identify manual processes and automate them to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities such as rightsizing, cleaning up unused resources, and tuning autoscaling.
* Follow security and compliance practices (HIPAA, access controls, secrets management) in all platform work.
* Maintain runbooks and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and support teams to improve application delivery.

**Required Skills**

* 3+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, DevOps, or Platform Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins.
* Proficiency in Terraform, Ansible, or other IaC tools.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Experience with Azure or another cloud platform.
* Strong troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with AKS, EKS, or OpenShift.
* Helm charts and Kubernetes administration.
* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK.
* Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments.
* Certifications such as CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator, or Terraform Associate.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Applications are deployed consistently using standardized Kubernetes patterns.
* Automation has measurably reduced manual work.
* Platform reliability has improved and incidents are resolved faster.
* Cost-saving actions have been delivered and documented.
* Runbooks and documentation are kept current.
